q1_issues.issue: "all the local waters" is a definite plural but is encoded as a single non-group witness (Member sk_waters_1 water) instead of the group witness (GroupOf ... water) a definite plural requires.
"local" is predicated directly of that singular witness rather than distributed over the members of the definite plural, as a descriptive modifier on a plural requires.
The explicit universal "all" over the object is dropped entirely — no per-member distribution over the waters and no QuantifierPhrase companion recording the word.
The distributing generic rule asserts that each individual fishing trawler fished out all the local waters, whereas the perfect-tense sentence makes a cumulative claim about trawlers collectively.

q2_gaps: Cumulative / episodic reading of a bare-plural subject (a perfect-tense clause about what a kind's members did collectively, not habitually) — the instruction set routes every bare-plural verbal subject to a distributing generic rule.
An explicit universal in OBJECT position ("V-ed all the Ns") — the universal-distribution machinery is specified for subjects and rule ranges, not for a universally quantified definite object.
notes: The compound decomposition is right — genus (Inheritance fishing_trawler trawler) emitted and the noun modifier "fishing" correctly not exposed — and the phrasal verb fish_out is kept whole with no genus.
